title: Patch: the fuzz forges the Trade and Marketplace actions its legal list never offered
thread:
**Issue #4143 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4143: Patch: the fuzz forges the Trade and Marketplace actions its legal list never offered
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

A player at the table sees which moves are offered and can only pick those. Today the automated game-player checks that promise for attacks, moves, card plays and card powers, but not for trading in a card or buying and selling at the shop. Once built, a game where the rules engine quietly accepts a trade or a shop deal that was never offered fails the test run with a message naming the move, before it can reach real players. For example, using a trade a second time in one turn, or buying a shop card without enough coins, would be caught even though no button offered it.

## Why

The server applies a move without asking what the menus offered (see the I8 header in the oracle: "as the server reduces without `legal_actions`"). Trade is limited (once a turn, `TRADES_PER_TURN`, R1838000) and shop deals check coins, tickets, stock and turn phase (R1853003, R2250002). The oracle function `unlisted_accepted` in `crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs` forges only `SwitchPosition`, `Attack`, `activate`/`activatePower` and `play` from the board and hand; a search for `trade`, `marketBuy` or `marketSell` in that file finds only report payload readers, no forged bodies. The converse check I14 (every listed action is accepted) does not cover this direction, and the gate docs in `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs` describe I8 as covering only "play, attack, switch or activation". So an unlisted economic action that `reduce` accepts is currently silent.

## Proposal

Extend `unlisted_accepted` to forge the economic bodies: a `trade` for each Tradable hand card when the listing holds no trade of it (including the already-traded-this-turn case), a `marketBuy` for each shop offer index (including out-of-stock, short-of-coins and wrong-phase cases), and a `marketSell` for an eligible and an ineligible hand card. Reuse the existing `accepts`/`accepts_as` helpers on the cloned probe state with `PROBE_NONCE`, and report with the same `I8 unlisted ... accepted` message shape citing SPEC §10.2 and the Trade/Marketplace rules. Update the I8 paragraph in the oracle header and the gate list in `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs` to name the new forged kinds. No rules change and no new ruling: this holds existing refusals, it does not decide one.

## Where it lands

- `crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs`: `unlisted_accepted`, the I8 header docs, `I8_GATE_STRIDE` comment if the cost moves
- `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs`: gate/I8 prose ("play, attack, switch or activation" line)
- SPEC sections read, not changed: §10.2 (actions), §10.8 (listings), §6.3 Trade and Marketplace, R1838000, R1838001, R1853003, R2250002

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A unit test crafts a state where no `trade` is listed (e.g. after one trade) and shows an accepted forged `trade` is reported as `I8 unlisted`.
- [ ] A unit test crafts a shop state short of coins (or with empty stock) and shows an accepted forged `marketBuy` is reported as `I8 unlisted`.
- [ ] A forged `marketSell` of a card with no sale quote that `reduce` accepts is likewise reported.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit` and the tools regression corpus stay green, with the stride cost noted (precedent: I8 stride 100 kept 103s near 104s).

## Size and risks

Medium: two files plus tests, test-only, no catalog or balance change. Risk is fuzz time if every offer is forged on every sampled state; mitigate by forging one body per card/offer and keeping the existing stride, measuring before/after as the stride comments do. Rejected alternative: re-checking the listing on the server instead of in fuzz; rejected because the server deliberately reduces without the listing, so the oracle must stay in the fuzz monitor.

---

## Goal

Extend I8's `unlisted_accepted` so it forges the economic actions it never forged. It will forge a `trade` for each hand card, a `marketBuy` for each shop offer index and a `marketSell` for each hand card. Update the I8 prose in the oracle header and in `crates/tools` to name the new kinds. Add engine tests for the three acceptance cases, and note the fuzz time before and after in the `I8_GATE_STRIDE` comment. No rules change and no new ruling.

## Files to touch

| File | Kind | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs` | change | `unlisted_accepted`: new forging block. Also the I8 header paragraph (lines 30–33), the doc comments of `unlisted_accepted` and of `InvariantMonitor::unlisted` (~line 3788), and the `I8_GATE_STRIDE` comment. |
| `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs` | change | Module doc, lines 24–25: the I8 clause "no unlisted play, attack, switch or activation `reduce` accepts, §4.1, §4.2, §10.2, §10.5". |
| `crates/tools/README.md` | change | Line 15 (the `fuzz` row), which says "I8 checking the unlisted attacks, switches and activations `reduce` accepts". |
| `crates/engine/tests/rules/tradable.rs` | change | Two new tests for the Trade (reuse `holding`, `trade_of`, `trade`, `trades_listed`). |
| `crates/engine/tests/rules/marketplace.rs` | change | Three new tests for buy and sell (reuse `board`, `credits`, `own_offers`, `buy_of`, `sell_of`, `buy`, `sell`, `buys_listed`, `sales_listed`, `hand_sale_board`, `slot_of`). |

## Steps

1. **Baseline timing, before any edit.** Run `nproc`, then `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200 2>&1 | tail -n 12`. From the `pool: … ; <N>s` summary line, write down the seconds (call it `T0`).

2. **`crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs`, `unlisted_accepted`.** Insert the block below right after the activation loop (`for card in &field { for (forged, listed) in forged_activations … }`). It goes before the `// I8's forged plays` comment and is **not** inside the `state.pending.is_none() …` guard. The switch, attack and activation forges are unguarded too, so a trade or deal accepted while a prompt is open or the game is over must be caught.
   - Hand loop: `for card in &state.players[player].hand { … }`.
     - If `accepts(ActionBody::Trade { instance_id: card.id.clone() })`, push `format!("I8 unlisted trade accepted: {player} may trade {} on turn {}, though legalActions does not list it (§10.2, R1838000)", name_of(card), state.turn)`.

   - Offer loop: `let offers = state.marketplace.as_ref().map_or(0, |market| market.offers.len());` then `for offer in 0..offers as i32`. This covers every index the Marketplace holds, including the other seat's lots, which are out of range for `player`.

   - Use only existing imports: `accepts`, `name_of`, `ActionBody`. Add nothing else.
   - Add a short comment above the block. Say that `trade::why_trade_refused` and `marketplace::why_market_buy_refused` / `why_market_sell_refused` are the reducer's own refusals (limit, coins, stock, phase), so the block fires only if the reducer's acceptance and the listing part ways.

3. **`invariants.rs` docs.**
   - Header I8 paragraph: change "every attack, switch, activation and play `reduce` accepts is listed (§4.1, §4.2, §9.1, §10.2, §10.5; #1192, #2978)" to "every attack, switch, activation, play, Trade, shop buy and shop sale `reduce` accepts is listed (…; R1838000, R1853003; #1192, #2978, #4143)". Keep the "Not probed:" and "Under a Mayor" sentences, and keep every line within 110 columns.
   - Doc of `unlisted_accepted`: add that a `trade` and a `marketSell` are forged for every hand card and a `marketBuy` for every offer index in the Marketplace.
   - Doc of `unlisted()`: "every unlisted attack, switch, activation and play" becomes "… play, Trade, buy and sale".

4. **`fuzz.rs` and `crates/tools/README.md` docs.** Change the fuzz.rs clause to "no unlisted play, attack, switch, activation, Trade or Marketplace deal `reduce` accepts, §4.1, §4.2, §6.3, §10.2, §10.5". In the README row, change "unlisted attacks, switches and activations" to "unlisted attacks, switches, activations, plays, Trades and Marketplace deals". Edit that long line in place and leave the rest alone.

5. **Tests** (below). Run `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test rules_3 i8_` and `… --test rules i8_` and fix until green.

6. **Re-time.** Run `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200 2>&1 | tail -n 12` and write down `T1`.
   - Append to the `I8_GATE_STRIDE` comment: "Measured on 2026-11-18 (<nproc> cores), seeds 1–200, after #4143's Trade and Marketplace forges: `cargo jackioh fuzz` <T0> s before, <T1> s after, at this stride." Use only the real numbers.
   - If T1 is more than about 10% over T0, rerun once to rule out noise. If it still stands, report it in the final report rather than raising the stride. The stride value stays 100.
   - If the wave reports a new `I8 unlisted trade/marketBuy/marketSell` violation, that is a real engine bug. Do not weaken the check. Report the seed and message, and keep the check.

## Tests

**`crates/engine/tests/rules/tradable.rs`** (uses `holding`, `trade_of`, `trade`, `trades_listed`; `unlisted_accepted` comes from `jackioh_engine::testkit::*`):

- `i8_is_clean_when_the_trade_is_listed_and_when_the_turn_s_one_trade_is_made`
  - `let (state, spell, _unit) = holding("i8-trade-clean")`.
  - Assert `legal_actions(&state, P1)` contains `trade_of(&spell)`.
  - Assert `unlisted_accepted(&state, P1, &legal)` is empty.
  - Make the trade: `let after = trade(&state, P1, &spell, "t1").state`. Assert `trades_listed(&after, P1)` is empty.
  - For every card in `after.players.p1.hand`, assert `trade(&after, P1, &card.id, "t2").error.is_some()`. This proves the silence below comes from a refusal, not from a listing.
  - Assert `unlisted_accepted(&after, P1, &legal_actions(&after, P1))` is empty.
- `i8_fires_on_a_trade_reduce_accepts_that_the_list_leaves_out`
  - Take `legal_actions` minus `trade_of(&spell)`, after asserting it was listed.
  - `found = unlisted_accepted(&state, P1, &legal)`: assert `found.len() == 1`.
  - Assert `found[0]` starts with `I8 unlisted trade accepted`, contains `spell`, contains `R1838000` and contains `§10.2`. The plain Unit in hand is Not Tradable and is refused, so it adds nothing.

**`crates/engine/tests/rules/marketplace.rs`:**

- `i8_stays_clean_where_the_marketplace_refuses_a_deal_the_list_does_not_hold`
  - Closed: `board("i8-closed", "p1", json!({}), json!({}))`. Assert `unlisted_accepted(&state, P1, &legal_actions(&state, P1))` is empty.
  - Open: `credits(&mut s, P1, 1000)` on a clone, with the full list, is empty.
  - Short of coins: set `market_credits = Some(0)` on a clone and assert `buy(&short, P1, at).error.is_some()`, `buys_listed(&short, P1)` is empty and the oracle is empty.
  - Out of stock: in a clone, for each `(at, lot)` in `own_offers(&s, P1)`, set `offers[slot_of(&s, P1, at)].bought[P1] = lot.stock`. Assert the same three things.
  - Wrong turn: clone with `active = P2`. Assert `buy(…).error` is `Some("it is not your turn")` and the oracle is empty. This copies the `theirs` pattern in `r1853003_r2250002_the_listing_the_refusal_and_the_view_agree`.
- `i8_fires_on_a_buy_reduce_accepts_that_the_list_leaves_out`
  - `board("i8-buy", "p1", …)`, `credits(&mut state, P1, 1000)`, `let (at, lot) = own_offers(&state, P1)[0].clone()`.
  - Assert `buy_of(at)` is in `legal_actions`, then remove it from the list.
  - Assert exactly one finding. It starts with `I8 unlisted marketBuy accepted`, contains `offer {at}`, `lot.def_id` and `R1853003`.
- `i8_fires_on_a_sale_reduce_accepts_that_the_list_leaves_out`
  - `hand_sale_board("i8-sale", json!({ "hand": ["fx-1", HAND_SALE] }), json!({}))`, then `credits(&mut state, P1, 10)`.
  - Let `hand` be the ids of p1's hand. Assert `sales_listed(&state, P1) == vec![hand[1].clone()]`.
  - Full list: the oracle is empty. The ineligible `fx-1` forged sale is refused and silent. Add `assert!(sell(&state, P1, &hand[0]).error.is_some())`.
  - List minus `sell_of(&hand[1])`: exactly one finding. It starts with `I8 unlisted marketSell accepted` and contains `hand[1]` and `R1853003`.

Commands:
- `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test rules_3 i8_` (the tradable file is in `mod_3.rs`)
- `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test rules i8_` (the marketplace file is in `mod.rs`)
- `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards --test cross i8` (the old I8 tests must still pass)
- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools` (the fuzz sweep runs I8 on every state of seeds 1–20)
- `cargo jackioh fuzz --regress`

## Done when

- [ ] `unlisted_accepted` forges `trade`, `marketBuy` and `marketSell` and reports `I8 unlisted … accepted` messages citing §10.2 and the rulings.
- [ ] The I8 docs are updated in `invariants.rs`, `fuzz.rs` and `crates/tools/README.md`.
- [ ] The trade, buy and sell tests above pass. Together they cover the already-traded, short-of-coins, out-of-stock, wrong-turn and ineligible-card silences.
- [ ] The `I8_GATE_STRIDE` comment holds the real before/after fuzz seconds from steps 1 and 6.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit`, the cards cross I8 tests, `cargo test -p jackioh-tools` and `cargo jackioh fuzz --regress` are green.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200` shows no new I8 violation.
- [ ] Harness checks pass: rustfmt, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `patches check`, `spec check`, clippy (including `-p jackioh-engine --all-targets`, `-p jackioh-tools`), the cargo tests, and no diff under `apps/web/src/wire`.
- [ ] Rule 12 holds: no red check is reported green.

## Risks

- **A trimmed list stands in for an engine divergence.** The reducer's `apply_trade`, `apply_market_buy` and `apply_market_sell` call the same `why_*_refused` functions `legal_actions` uses. A correct engine therefore never yields an accepted-but-unlisted deal, and the real fuzz stays silent. The tests make the divergence by removing one entry from the real list, as the existing `without(...)` I8 tests do.
- **Fuzz cost.** At most about 2 reduces per hand card plus one per offer, per I8 sample. I8 runs every 100th state in the gate, and a listed body costs nothing. Step 6 records the measurement. Do not change the stride.
- **Purity and determinism.** The probe state is a clone with `applied` cleared and reduces under `PROBE_NONCE`. It touches no rng, no I/O and no wire types, so nothing under `apps/web/src/wire` should change. If `git status -- apps/web/src/wire` shows a diff, stop and report it.
- **A genuine fuzz hit.** Report it with the seed and message. Never weaken the check, add an allow or skip a test.

## Open questions

- None block the build. Decisions the task left open, with the alternative rejected:
  - Forging for every hand card, not only Tradable or sale-eligible ones. This also catches a dropped `is_tradable` or `sells_from_hand` refusal. Tradable-only would miss it.
  - Reading acceptance criterion 1 literally is impossible with a correct reducer ("no trade listed, yet a forged trade accepted"). The criterion is therefore met by a list trimmed to omit an acceptable trade (must fire) and by the already-traded state (must stay silent). The same reading applies to the buy and sale criteria.
  - The economic forges run unguarded by `pending`, `mulligan` and `result`, matching the switch, attack and activation forges, so a deal accepted at the wrong time is caught. Guarding them like plays would hide the wrong-phase cases the issue names.
  - The tests live in the existing `tradable.rs` and `marketplace.rs` (their helpers and fixtures are there), so no module registration changes. A new module would have needed one in `mod_3.rs`.
```
